input: Find academic, tutoring, reading, writing, language, chess, math and test prep summer camps and summer programs for kids and teens in or near Asheville, NC (every part of the city: downtown, West, North, South and East Asheville). Search the web thoroughly (several searches with different wording and town names) and list every organization you find.
searches: Asheville summer 2026 reading writing math chess academic camp
Carolina Day School summer 2026 Key reading
Grow Abroad Asheville summer camp 2025 2026 language

candidates.name: Asheville Math
candidates.note: Summer game camps include chess, strategy games and game design; also offers Dungeons & Dragons camps.

candidates.name: Zaniac Asheville
candidates.note: 2026 camps included individualized Math Boot Camp and STEM programs at North and South Asheville locations.

candidates.name: Biltmore Tutoring
candidates.note: Small-group, one-week SAT and ACT summer boot camps in South Asheville; 2027 dates expected in spring.

candidates.name: Spanish Academy of Asheville
candidates.note: Spanish-learning summer camps with gardening, crafts and science themes, weekdays 8:30 a.m.–3 p.m.

candidates.name: University of North Carolina Asheville
candidates.note: Residential pre-college programs include the Great Smokies Young Writers Workshop; also runs SkillSet summer camps.

candidates.name: Literacy Together
candidates.note: Summer literacy tutoring at partner camp sites; served more than 100 K–6 students during summer 2025.

candidates.name: YTL Training Programs
candidates.note: K–12 summer learning camps combine academic support, STEM and agricultural enrichment; June–August 2026.

candidates.name: Christine W. Avery Learning Center
candidates.note: School-age summer camps include literacy enrichment, STEAM, creative arts and leadership activities.

candidates.name: Horizons at Carolina Day School
candidates.note: Summer academic enrichment includes reading and math, arts and swimming; 2026 literacy partnership with CDS Key Learning Center.

candidates.name: Carolina Day School
candidates.note: August 10–14, 2026 enrichment camps for rising JK–grade 6; restricted to students enrolled for 2026–27.

candidates.name: Buncombe County Schools
candidates.note: 2026 reading camps for grades 2–3 at sites in Asheville, Candler, Leicester, Weaverville and Black Mountain.

candidates.name: Buncombe County Public Libraries
candidates.note: Summer reading and library activities across county branches; 2027 theme is Mysteries Await at Your Library.

candidates.name: City of Asheville
candidates.note: CAYLA places high-school students in summer jobs with weekly workshops on financial literacy, leadership and careers.

candidates.name: The Learning Community School
candidates.note: Two-week Summer Academy reinforces reading, writing and math for rising grades 1–6; also nature and theater camps.

candidates.name: Asheville Christian Academy
candidates.note: 2026 summer day camps offered skill-building, sports and reinforcement in academic subjects.

candidates.name: Tutors Across America
candidates.note: Ran a three-day, 20-hour ACT/SAT boot camp at Asheville Christian Academy July 27–29, 2026.

candidates.name: Blue Ridge Community College
candidates.note: 2026 Summer Academy offered hands-on educational camps for elementary, middle and high-school students.

candidates.name: Henderson County Public Schools
candidates.note: Read to Achieve provides summer reading intervention for third-graders who are not reading at grade level.

candidates.name: Henderson County Public Library
candidates.note: June–July 2026 summer reading included children’s and teen activities at the main library and county branches.

candidates.name: Brevard College
candidates.note: Campus Adventures educational enrichment for rising grades 1–7; 2027 program scheduled July 19–23.

candidates.name: Camp Spring Creek
candidates.note: Residential dyslexia camp for ages 7–15 with individual reading instruction; June 20–July 31, 2027.

candidates.name: North Carolina School of Science and Mathematics
candidates.note: Academic summer programs include 2026 Morganton Early Accelerator day camps for rising grades 5–6.

candidates.name: East Tennessee State University
candidates.note: 2026 Renaissance camps offered STEAM learning; additional teen summer programs included pharmacy exploration.
